$comment: Website screenshots (docs/SCREENSHOTS.md). Captured by scripts/capture-screenshots.mjs from the live demo company in presentation mode, production build. Each shot waits for its 'ready' text and passes the quality gate before it is written. 'feature' links to src/lib/site/features.ts.

shots.alt: The Taviron Command Center for a demo company: the items that need attention, urgent ones first, with today's work
shots.caption: Command Center. The live demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: Plan the day in a demo company: plans compared by loads covered, urgent loads and estimated revenue, with each proposed truck and driver and what still needs review
shots.caption: Plan the day. Demo company, fictional data. Nothing is assigned until a dispatcher approves.

shots.alt: The dispatch board for a demo company: urgent orders, orders waiting for a date, Smart Dispatch suggestions and the day's loads
shots.caption: Dispatch. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: An order in a demo company with its progress across dispatch, delivery tickets and billing readiness, and its history
shots.caption: Order detail. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: Delivery Tickets in a demo company, filtered to tickets that need review: each with its paper ticket number, order and customer, delivered quantity, truck and driver
shots.caption: Delivery tickets. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: The driver's My Day on a phone: today's load with site, truck and planned tons, and buttons to enter the ticket or report a problem
shots.caption: Driver portal on a phone. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: Maintenance in a demo company: open work orders with urgency, a safety-critical brake defect holding a truck out of dispatch, and preventive schedules coming due
shots.caption: Maintenance. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: The fleet overview for a demo company: trucks and trailers with service status, documents expiring soon and equipment needing attention
shots.caption: Fleet. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: Billing readiness in a demo company: orders by readiness, with what still blocks each one (missing or unverified tickets, review exceptions) and the orders ready for an invoice draft
shots.caption: Billing readiness. Demo company, fictional data. Drafts are prepared for review; nothing is sent.

shots.alt: Communications in a demo company: the workspace for an order in dispatch, and notifications for expiring truck registrations and inspections, time-off requests and a critical truck restriction
shots.caption: Communications. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: The employee directory in a demo company: drivers, dispatch, office and shop staff with their role, department, primary truck and status, including a driver on leave
shots.caption: Employees. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: The Reports page in a demo company for the last 30 days: delivery tickets and review times, verified delivered value from accepted tickets, and totals by customer, material and truck
shots.caption: Reports. Demo company, fictional data. Measured from recorded tickets and orders; nothing is estimated.

shots.alt: Company setup in a demo company: a checklist of what Taviron needs before its checks and plans can rely on the data (company profile, people and roles, customers, materials and rates, trucks and drivers), with what is still missing
shots.caption: Company setup. Demo company, fictional data.

shots.alt: Time estimates in a demo company: typical hours per kind of job learned from logged labor, and estimate against actual by job and by mechanic
